# Action catalog

Every action can be called from server code (`callAction`), over REST
(`POST /api/v1/actions/<name>`) and over MCP (tool name = action name with `.` → `_`).
See [actions.md](./actions.md) for how the system works.

## Permissions by role

| Permission | Meaning | owner | admin | manager | staff |
| --- | --- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| `admin.access` | Open the admin app (/admin). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `users.read` | View and search all contacts (people, customers, staff). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `users.manage` | Create, edit, archive and restore contacts, and add or remove their tags; create and delete tags. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `roles.manage` | Grant and revoke staff roles. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `activity.read` | View the activity log and the change history of records. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `errors.manage` | View error reports with full technical detail (stack traces, inputs) and mark them fixed. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `api_keys.manage` | Create and revoke API keys for yourself (REST API and MCP). | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `settings.manage` | Change business settings and integrations in Admin → Settings. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `docs.internal` | Read internal (staff-only) docs at /docs and over the API/MCP. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `automations.manage` | Create, edit, turn on/off and test automations, see their runs and the event log. Automations act as the system, so only owners and admins have this. | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `notifications.manage` | See every notification sent to anyone and its delivery status; retry failed ones. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |  |
| `system.manage` | See system health, scheduled jobs and background jobs; retry or cancel jobs. (Technical — owners and admins.) | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |

### contacts.list

**List contacts** — Search and list contacts (customers, leads, staff, vendors — everyone). Filter by tag slug (e.g. tag="customer") and/or a free-text search over name, email, phone and company. Archived contacts are hidden unless includeArchived is true.

- Who: `users.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { contacts: Contact[] (each with tags, roles, hasLogin), total: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tag": {
      "description": "Only contacts with this tag slug, e.g. \"customer\", \"lead\", \"staff\".",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "search": {
      "description": "Matches name, email, phone or company (partial, case-insensitive).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "includeArchived": {
      "default": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    },
    "offset": {
      "default": 0,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  }
}
```

### contacts.get

**Get contact** — Fetch one contact by id, including tags, staff roles and whether they have a login.

- Who: `users.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: Contact (with tags, roles, hasLogin)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
      "description": "Contact id."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.create

**Create contact** — Create a contact — anyone the business deals with. Say what they are with tags: e.g. tags=["lead"] for a new lead, ["customer"], ["staff","customer"] for an employee who is also a customer, ["vendor"]. Tags only describe the person; they do NOT grant app access (use access.grantRole for that). Fails with "conflict" if the email already exists — use contacts.list to find that contact instead.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The new Contact (with tags, roles, hasLogin)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "firstName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "lastName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "companyName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "email": {
      "description": "Email address. Stored lower-case; must be unique across contacts.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "phone": {
      "description": "Phone number in any common format; stored as E.164 (+18165551234). US is assumed.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tags": {
      "default": [],
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "description": "Tag slugs, e.g. [\"customer\"] or [\"staff\",\"customer\"]. Use tags.list to see them."
    }
  }
}
```

### contacts.update

**Update contact** — Change a contact’s details. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear a field. To change tags use contacts.addTags / contacts.removeTags. Changing the email of someone who has a login or a staff role needs roles.manage (the email is how a login finds its contact, so it is security-sensitive). Every change is kept in the record history (activity.changes).

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",

    },
    "firstName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "lastName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "companyName": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "email": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "description": "Email address. Stored lower-case; must be unique across contacts.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "phone": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "description": "Phone number in any common format; stored as E.164 (+18165551234). US is assumed.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.archive

**Archive contact** — Disable a contact and hide them from lists without deleting their history: their login and API keys stop working everywhere. Reversible with contacts.restore. Contacts are never hard-deleted through actions. The last owner cannot be archived.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, status }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### contacts.addTags

**Add tags to contact** — Add one or more tags to a contact, e.g. tags=["customer"] when a lead buys for the first time. Adding a tag the contact already has is a no-op. Tags never grant app access.

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "tags": {
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "description": "Tag slugs, e.g. [\"customer\"] or [\"staff\",\"customer\"]. Use tags.list to see them."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "tags"
  ]
}
```

{

### tags.create

**Create tag** — Create a new tag. Use kind="type" only for a new top-level contact category (it appears in the admin Contacts menu); otherwise kind="label".

- Who: `users.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The new Tag

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "slug": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$",
      "description": "Machine name, e.g. \"net-30\". Permanent."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60
    },
    "kind": {
      "default": "label",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "type",
        "label"
      ]
    },
    "color": {
      "default": "neutral",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "neutral",
        "brand",
        "blue",
        "green",
        "amber",
        "red",
        "purple",
        "teal"
      ]
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 300
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "slug",
    "label"
  ]
}
```

### access.grantRole

**Grant role** — Give a contact a staff role, which unlocks /admin. The person signs in with their normal login (the contact must have one, or will get the role when they first sign in with that email). Only owners can grant "owner"; owners and admins can grant the rest.

- Who: `roles.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: The updated Contact

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contactId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "owner",
        "admin",
        "manager",
        "staff"
      ],
      "description": "owner: Everything, including managing other staff and owners. | admin: Everything except granting the owner role. | manager: Runs day-to-day operations in admin: people, activity, notifications, settings. | staff: Admin access for day-to-day work; read-only on people and settings."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "contactId",
    "role"
  ]
}
```

### activity.list

**List activity** — The audit trail, newest first: every change (successful or not), every sign-in/sign-out and password event, every denied attempt, and every API/MCP call including reads — who (person, API key/AI, system), which channel (web, api, mcp, system), from which IP, what, and whether it worked. Filter by subject to see one record’s history, by actor or API key to see what someone (or an AI) did. Page with `before` = the occurredAt of the last row. Use activity.get for one entry’s field-level changes.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: ActivityEntry[] with actorName and apiKeyName

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subjectId": {
      "description": "Only entries about this record, e.g. a contact id.",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "actorContactId": {
      "description": "Only entries by this person (including their API keys).",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "apiKeyId": {
      "description": "Only entries made with this API key.",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    },
    "requestId": {
      "description": "Only entries from one web/API request.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "action": {
      "description": "Only this action name, e.g. \"contacts.update\" or \"auth.signIn\".",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kind": {
      "description": "change, read (API/MCP reads) or auth.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "change",
        "read",
        "auth"
      ]
    },
    "channel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "web",
        "api",
        "mcp",
        "system",
        "cli",
        "automation"
      ]
    },
    "failedOnly": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "Only failures (denied, invalid input, errors).",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "q": {
      "description": "Search the summary and action name.",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 2
    },
    "before": {
      "description": "Only entries older than this (for paging).",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### activity.get

**Get activity entry** — One audit entry in full: who, how, from where (IP, browser), the input, and every database row it changed with before → after values. Also lists the other entries from the same request.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { entry, changes: ChangeEntry[], sameRequest: ActivityEntry[] }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### activity.changes

**Record history** — Field-level history of a record (a contact, product …): every insert, update and delete with before → after values, newest first, and who made it. Captured by the database itself, so it includes changes made outside the app (e.g. directly in the database) — those have no activityId and show the database user.

- Who: `activity.read`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, occurredAt, tableName, rowId, op, before, after, dbUser, activityId, action, actorKind, actorName, apiKeyName, channel }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subjectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
      "description": "The record, e.g. a contact id or product id."
    },
    "before": {
      "description": "Only changes older than this (for paging).",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "subjectId"
  ]
}
```

### errors.list

**List errors** — Unexpected failures (bugs and outages), grouped: occurrences of the same bug share a fingerprint and are listed once with a count. Each group shows its newest reference — pass that to errors.get for the full report (stack, input, diagnosis). Open = at least one occurrence not marked fixed.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ fingerprint, ref, code, message, source, action, path, count, openCount, firstSeen, lastSeen, resolution }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "default": "open",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "open",
        "resolved",
        "all"
      ]
    },
    "sinceDays": {
      "default": 30,
      "description": "Only errors seen in this window.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 365
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### errors.get

**Get error report** — Everything known about one error, for fixing it: the diagnosis (code + hint), message, stack trace, cause chain, the action and its input (secrets redacted), who hit it and where, the deployed commit, how often the same bug has happened, and what else happened in the same request. `brief` is all of that as one Markdown document — start there. After fixing, call errors.resolve.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { error, actorName, apiKeyName, occurrences, recentRefs, relatedActivity, brief }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 4,
      "description": "The error reference people see, e.g. \"E-7K3QX9MD\" (or a Next.js error digest)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ref"
  ]
}
```

### errors.resolve

**Mark error fixed** — Mark a bug fixed: every open occurrence with the same fingerprint as this reference is closed with your note. Say what fixed it (commit, PR link). If the bug happens again it shows up as open again.

- Who: `errors.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { resolved: number }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 4,
      "description": "The error reference people see, e.g. \"E-7K3QX9MD\" (or a Next.js error digest)."
    },
    "resolution": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 2000,
      "description": "What fixed it, e.g. \"Fixed in a1b2c3d — null check in contacts.update (PR #42)\"."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ref",
    "resolution"
  ]
}
```

### apiKeys.list

**List my API keys** — Your own API keys (the secret itself is never shown again after creation).

- Who: `api_keys.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: ApiKey[] (without secrets)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### apiKeys.create

**Create API key** — Create a key for the REST API or the MCP server (for AI assistants like Claude). The key acts as YOU, optionally limited to some of your permissions. The secret is returned ONCE — store it safely.

- Who: `api_keys.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { key (secret, shown once), apiKey }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 80,
      "description": "What it is for, e.g. \"Claude desktop\"."
    },
    "permissions": {
      "description": "Limit the key to these permissions. Omit for all of your permissions.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "admin.access",
          "users.read",
          "users.manage",
          "roles.manage",
          "activity.read",
          "errors.manage",
          "api_keys.manage",
          "settings.manage",
          "docs.internal",
          "automations.manage",
          "notifications.manage",
          "system.manage"
        ]
      }
    },
    "expiresInDays": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 365
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ]
}
```

### apiKeys.revoke

**Revoke API key** — Permanently disable one of your API keys. Anything using it stops working immediately.

- Who: `api_keys.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### settings.list

**List settings** — Every business setting (key → JSON value). Settings are plain configuration, never secrets.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ key, value, updatedAt }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### settings.get

**Get a setting** — One setting by key; `value` is null when it has never been set.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { key, value }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$",
      "description": "Setting key, dotted, e.g. \"business.name\"."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "key"
  ]
}
```

### settings.set

**Change a setting** — Create or replace one setting. The value can be any JSON. Never store secrets here — they belong in environment variables.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { key, value }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$",
      "description": "Setting key, dotted, e.g. \"business.name\"."
    },
    "value": {
      "description": "Any JSON value.",
      "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "key",
    "value"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "__schema0": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "propertyNames": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "additionalProperties": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### integrations.list

**List integrations** — Outside services with whether they are configured (from environment variables — names only, never values), and whether staff have switched them on or off (kill switch) plus their non-secret config.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, label, description, core, configured, missing[], invalid[], enabled, config }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### integrations.update

**Switch an integration on/off or change its config** — Kill switch and non-secret config for one integration (an id from integrations.list). Whether it is configured still comes from environment variables.

- Who: `settings.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, enabled, config }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Integration id, e.g. \"email\" or \"sms\"."
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "config": {
      "description": "Replaces the non-secret config.",
      "type": "object",
      "propertyNames": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### system.whoami

**Who am I** — Who the caller is acting as, their roles and permissions, and which environment (production/test) this is. Call this first to understand what you are allowed to do.

- Who: `authenticated`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { kind, contactId, roles, permissions, channel, environment }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### system.integrations

**Integration status** — Which outside services (database, sign-in, email, SMS, storage …) are configured in this environment, and the NAMES of the variables still missing. Never returns secret values.

- Who: `system.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, label, description, core, configured, missing[], invalid[] }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### system.health

**System health** — Is everything running? Database, the scheduled crons (last run, last error, stale or not), the background-job queue sizes by status, and the registered job types.

- Who: `system.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: { ok, environment, commit, checks, crons, queues, jobTypes }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

### jobs.list

**List background jobs** — Background jobs, newest first: type, status, attempts, when it runs next, the last error and (for failed jobs) the error reference for errors.get. Filter by status and type.

- Who: `system.manage`
- Changes data: no
- Returns: [{ id, type, status, attempts, maxAttempts, runAt, lastError, errorRef, result, payload, createdAt, finishedAt }]

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "description": "Only these statuses (default: all).",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "pending",
          "running",
          "done",
          "failed",
          "cancelled"
        ]
      }
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  }
}
```

### jobs.retry

**Retry a job** — Run a failed or cancelled job again now, with a fresh set of attempts. Fix the cause first (see its errorRef) or it will just fail again.

- Who: `system.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, status }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```

### jobs.cancel

**Cancel a job** — Stop a waiting (pending) job from running.

- Who: `system.manage`
- Changes data: yes (written to the activity log)
- Returns: { id, status }

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id"
  ]
}
```
